== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB5-L-macewinduai-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip of the base card ([[:File:VB5-44E-Mace_Windu.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the PC website card list entry for the AI printing (by 21 July 2012). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1250_45ai</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
